DOCUMENTATION

Data dictionary

Definitions for every field in the three public CSV exports. Each file contains one row per published evaluation, currently 28 records.

Decision use and transferable lesson

Decision use answers “What could I use this report to inform?” It is an analyst assessment of a decision, assumption or delivery issue. Transferable lesson answers “What could be learned from the findings and applied elsewhere?” It may be explicit in the source or inferred by the analyst. Always read the lesson basis and evidence limits.

FieldIllustrative example
decision_useAssess instructor capacity and quality measures when planning military training.
transferable_lessonUse structured learner feedback to improve training delivery.

These examples explain the distinction; they are not additional source findings. A useful decision application does not establish that a lesson transfers successfully.

Files and conventions

  • evaluation_summaries.csv: narrative summaries, source metadata and editorial assessments.
  • evaluation_sources.csv: source matching, references and original seed metadata, plus editorial assessments.
  • content_review.csv: selection decisions and screening metadata.

All three files share evaluation_id. They describe the same records and should not be appended as separate evaluations. Blank means not populated or unavailable, not zero or a negative finding. Explicit uncertainty statements in text should be retained.

CSV files use UTF-8 with a byte-order mark, a header row and quoted values where needed. Dates retain their supplied precision: YYYY, YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD. Do not invent missing months or days. Lists use semicolon separators, except PDF-page fields which use commas. In data.js, list fields are arrays and criteria_results is an object; the CSV exports flatten these values.

Source narratives and analyst assessments are distinct. Findings describe the source evidence period. Decision use, MOD relevance and transfer boundaries are editorial assessments. Selection and source-access labels are not quality scores. Business-case mappings and selection metadata remain in exports even where removed from the detail-page interface.

Power BI import

Import identifiers, references, URLs, partial dates and narrative fields as Text. Use Whole number for seed_row, priority_rank and pdf_page_count when populated. Use evaluation_id for relationships and drill-through. If a date axis is needed, derive a separate date column with an explicit precision rule and keep the original text. Split multi-value tags into related tables for slicers. Set URL columns to the Web URL data category.

Field reference

File codes: S = evaluation_summaries.csv; R = evaluation_sources.csv; C = content_review.csv. Definitions describe stored fields, including historical metadata that is not shown in the interface.

FieldFormatDefinitionFiles
evaluation_idText keyStable unique record identifier, such as EVAL-001. Use for joins and drill-through.S, R, C
source_titleTextReport title used in the library.S, R, C
countryCategoryCountry associated with the report; UK is displayed as United Kingdom.S, R
source_report_dateDate textDate printed on or assigned to the report; may contain year, year-month or full date.S, R
evaluation_questionLong textQuestion assessed by the report, stated or synthesised as described in question_basis.S
methodsLong textSummary of study design, evidence collection and analysis.S
findingsLong textSummary of observed results reported by the source.S
recommendationsLong textActions recommended by the report; see recommendation_basis for attribution.S
conclusionsLong textOverall conclusions reported or synthesised from the source; see conclusion_basis.S
source_publisherTextOrganisation publishing the source; may differ from the evaluating organisation.S, R
evaluating_organisationTextOrganisation conducting or responsible for the assessment.S, R
seed_domainLegacy categoryDomain supplied in the original seed catalogue; retained for traceability.S, R
question_basisTextWhether the question is explicit in the report or synthesised by the analyst.S
recommendation_basisTextBasis and attribution of the recommendations summary.S
conclusion_basisTextBasis and attribution of the conclusions summary.S

recommendations_pdf_pagesComma-separated integersPDF file page numbers supporting recommendations, counting the cover as page 1. Blank when PDF locators are unavailable; consult evidence_locator.S
conclusions_pdf_pagesComma-separated integersPDF file page numbers supporting conclusions, counting the cover as page 1. Blank when PDF locators are unavailable; consult evidence_locator.S
